notes.title: Indie Game 《Zen&》 Update Announcement Feb 27th
notes.content:
Hello Zen& Bead Masters! ✨

✦ This update is about:
[New Feature] 👁 Pure Mode
Tap the eye icon (bottom-right) to hide all UI.

[Optimizations] 🎨
Fixed UI misalignment on select devices.

 Get instant help in our Discord community

Best regards,
Dev Team
